operator: enum: [M01_DATA_LEAK, M02_BASELINE_HANDICAP, M03_SEED_CHERRY_PICK, M04_SUBGROUP_DROP, M05_METRIC_SWAP, M06_AGGREGATION_FAULT, M07_TEST_SET_SELECTION, M08_PREPROCESS_ASYMMETRY]
precondition: string, condition required before mutation applies
diff_sha256: string, hash of the mutation diff for reproducibility
independent_oracle_result: boolean, whether oracle confirms claim is now invalid
